A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] '''florist''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around [[3960 BBY]], and frequently purchased [[Plant/Legends|plants]] from the farmer [[Jelph Marrian|Jelph of Marisota]]. When the [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]] questioned the florist on the origin of his plants, the Keshiri lied by telling her that he had grown the plants himself. Kitai later followed the florist to [[Jelph Marrian's farm|Jelph's farm]] on her [[uvak]]. Thus, Orielle started a close friendship with Jelph which set a chain of events that led to the discovery of Jelph's [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighter]] and the [[Night of the Upside-Down Meteor]], which led to the death of [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]] and [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]].
